name: Summer Camp at Fairfield Nature Center
description_short: Weekly outdoor nature day camp at the Connecticut Audubon Society's Fairfield Nature Center, with small groups for ages 4 through completed 7th grade and a Counselor-in-Training program for ages 14-18. Sessions run outdoors rain or shine.
refund_policy_summary: Optional Registration Protection can be bought at checkout and gives a full refund for specified reasons such as illness, injury or work relocation. Without it, requests must be made by email. Changes must be requested at least two weeks before the session. Cancellations before June 1 are refunded minus a 20% fee per program, and membership fees are not refunded. There are no refunds after June 1. If the camp cancels a program, you get a full refund.

warnings: The page only covers the 2026 season (June 8 – August 14, 2026), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. No 2027 information is available yet.
Individual weekly session dates, themes and prices are not listed on the page. They are in the separate 2026 brochure, which was not provided, so no sessions were recorded.
Families must hold a Connecticut Audubon Society membership at Chickadee level ($58 family) or higher to register. This cost is on top of camp fees.
Grade groups are based on the grade completed in June, not the grade the child is entering. 'Completed 6th–7th grade' means children going into 7th or 8th grade.
age_max of 18 refers to the Counselor-in-Training program. Regular camper groups stop after completed 7th grade.
The health forms section mentions ctaudubon.org/pomfret-camp, which looks like a copy-paste from another location's page.
